data.gen-pools.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Generates Substrate's CA pools and JWT pool into $OUT, one directory per
# secret, in the format kagent's installer writes (pkg/install/substrate_init.go):
#   CA pool: pool (JSON), tls.crt, tls.key        JWT pool: pool, jwks
# Runs in an openssl container. apply-pools.sh creates only the missing Secrets.
set -eu
OUT="${OUT:-/out}"
b64() { base64 -w0 "$1"; }
b64url() { base64 -w0 "$1" | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '='; }

# ca_pool <dir> <ed25519|p256>
ca_pool() {
    dir="$OUT/$1"; mkdir -p "$dir"
    case "$2" in
        ed25519) openssl genpkey -algorithm ED25519 -out "$dir/tls.key" ;;
        p256) openssl genpkey -algorithm EC -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -out "$dir/tls.key" ;;
    esac
    openssl req -x509 -new -key "$dir/tls.key" -days 365 -subj "/CN=$(head -c 12 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')" \
        -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" -addext "keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyCertSign" \
        -out "$dir/tls.crt"
    openssl x509 -in "$dir/tls.crt" -outform DER -out "$dir/cert.der"
    openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt -in "$dir/tls.key" -outform DER -out "$dir/key.der"
    printf '{"CAs":[{"ID":"1","SigningKeyPKCS8":"%s","RootCertificateDER":"%s"}],"ActiveForSigning":"1"}' \
        "$(b64 "$dir/key.der")" "$(b64 "$dir/cert.der")" > "$dir/pool"
    rm -f "$dir/cert.der" "$dir/key.der"
}

ca_pool actor-id-ca-pool ed25519
ca_pool egress-mitm-ca-pool p256
ca_pool service-dns-ca-pool ed25519
ca_pool pod-identity-ca-pool ed25519
ca_pool postgres-ca-pool ed25519

# actor-id-ca-certs: the actor identity CA root, PEM.
mkdir -p "$OUT/actor-id-ca-certs"
cp "$OUT/actor-id-ca-pool/tls.crt" "$OUT/actor-id-ca-certs/ca.crt"

# actor-id-jwt-pool: one ES256 authority, plus its public JWKS.
dir="$OUT/actor-id-jwt-pool"; mkdir -p "$dir"
openssl genpkey -algorithm EC -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:P-256 -out "$dir/key.pem"
openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt -in "$dir/key.pem" -outform DER -out "$dir/key.der"
printf '{"Authorities":[{"ID":"1","Algorithm":"ES256","SigningKeyPKCS8":"%s"}],"ActiveForSigning":"1"}' \
    "$(b64 "$dir/key.der")" > "$dir/pool"
# Public point: the last 64 bytes of the SPKI DER are x||y.
openssl pkey -in "$dir/key.pem" -pubout -outform DER | tail -c 64 > "$dir/xy.bin"
head -c 32 "$dir/xy.bin" > "$dir/x.bin"; tail -c 32 "$dir/xy.bin" > "$dir/y.bin"
printf '{"keys":[{"kty":"EC","crv":"P-256","x":"%s","y":"%s","kid":"1","alg":"ES256","use":"sig"}]}' \
    "$(b64url "$dir/x.bin")" "$(b64url "$dir/y.bin")" > "$dir/jwks"
rm -f "$dir/key.pem" "$dir/key.der" "$dir/xy.bin" "$dir/x.bin" "$dir/y.bin"
echo "generated: $(ls "$OUT" | tr '\n' ' ')"
data.apply-pools.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Creates the Secrets and ConfigMap Substrate needs, only when missing, so reruns
# and upgrades keep the existing keys. Reads what gen-pools.sh wrote to $OUT.
set -eu
OUT="${OUT:-/out}"
ATE=ate-system
PODCERT=podcertificate-controller-system

# ensure <namespace> <name> <type> <key>...   (each key is a file in $OUT/<name>)
ensure() {
    ns="$1"; name="$2"; type="$3"; shift 3
    if kubectl get secret -n "$ns" "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "secret $ns/$name exists, keeping it"
        return
    fi
    args=""
    for key in "$@"; do args="$args --from-file=$key=$OUT/$name/$key"; done
    case "$type" in
        tls) kubectl create secret tls "$name" -n "$ns" --cert="$OUT/$name/tls.crt" --key="$OUT/$name/tls.key" --dry-run=client -o json \
                 | jq --rawfile pool "$OUT/$name/pool" '.data.pool = ($pool | @base64)' | kubectl create -f - ;;
        *) # shellcheck disable=SC2086
           kubectl create secret generic "$name" -n "$ns" $args ;;
    esac
}

ensure "$ATE" actor-id-jwt-pool generic pool jwks
ensure "$ATE" actor-id-ca-pool tls
ensure "$ATE" actor-id-ca-certs generic ca.crt
ensure "$ATE" egress-mitm-ca-pool tls
ensure "$PODCERT" service-dns-ca-pool tls
ensure "$PODCERT" pod-identity-ca-pool tls
ensure "$PODCERT" postgres-ca-pool tls

# The object store credentials the atelet and rustfs charts read. Chart defaults.
if ! kubectl get secret -n "$ATE" kagent-rustfs-credentials >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    kubectl create secret generic kagent-rustfs-credentials -n "$ATE" \
        --from-literal=AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=rustfsadmin --from-literal=AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=rustfsadmin
fi

# ate-api-authentication: trust the cluster's service account issuer.
if ! kubectl get configmap -n "$ATE" ate-api-authentication >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    issuer="$(kubectl get --raw /.well-known/openid-configuration | jq -r .issuer)"
    auth="jwtProviders:
- name: kubernetes
  issuer: $issuer
  audiences: [api.$ATE.svc]"
    case "$issuer" in
        https://kubernetes.default.svc|https://kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local)
            auth="$auth
  certificateAuthorityFile: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
  discoveryTokenFile: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token" ;;
    esac
    kubectl create configmap ate-api-authentication -n "$ATE" --from-literal=authentication.yaml="$auth"
fi
echo "bootstrap complete"

data.pg_hba.conf:
local all all trust
hostssl all postgres all reject
hostssl kagent kagent_owner_user,kagent_readwrite_user,substrate_owner_user,substrate_readwrite_user all cert
data.postgresql.conf:
listen_addresses = '*'
ssl = on
ssl_cert_file = '/run/servicedns.podcert.ate.dev/credential-bundle.pem'
ssl_key_file = '/run/servicedns.podcert.ate.dev/credential-bundle.pem'
ssl_ca_file = '/run/postgres.podcert.ate.dev/trust-bundle.pem'
hba_file = '/etc/postgresql/pg_hba.conf'
data.reload-tls.sh:
set -eu
trap 'exit 0' TERM INT

CERT=/run/servicedns.podcert.ate.dev/credential-bundle.pem
CA=/run/postgres.podcert.ate.dev/trust-bundle.pem
reloaded=""
while true; do
  current="$(sha256sum "$CERT" "$CA" /etc/postgresql/pg_hba.conf)"
  if [ "$current" != "$reloaded" ] \
    && psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d postgres -Atc 'SELECT pg_reload_conf()' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    reloaded="$current"
  fi
  sleep 60 &
  wait $!
done

containers.name: setup
command:
set -eu
kubectl -n kagent rollout status deployment/kagent-postgresql --timeout=5m
{ echo 'BEGIN;'; cat /sql/kagent-setup.sql; echo; cat /sql/substrate-setup.sql; echo; echo 'COMMIT;'; } | \
kubectl -n kagent exec -i deployment/kagent-postgresql -c postgresql -- \
  psql --no-psqlrc --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username postgres --dbname kagent \
  --set=kagent_schema=kagent --set=kagent_owner_role=kagent_owner --set=kagent_owner_user=kagent_owner_user --set=kagent_owner_password= \
  --set=kagent_readwrite_role=kagent_readwrite --set=kagent_readwrite_user=kagent_readwrite_user --set=kagent_readwrite_password= \
  --set=substrate_schema=substrate --set=substrate_owner_role=substrate_owner --set=substrate_owner_user=substrate_owner_user --set=substrate_owner_password= \
  --set=substrate_readwrite_role=substrate_readwrite --set=substrate_readwrite_user=substrate_readwrite_user --set=substrate_readwrite_password=
